Subject: Post-mitigation summary: FastCommerce evening p99 surge

Team / Ben / Miguel (cc'd),

Summary of what happened and actions taken (short):
- Impact: FastCommerce experienced a streaming chat p99 regression beginning ~18:05 PT affecting a subset of VIP channels; brief 5xx spike (~4%) and user retries.
- Immediate mitigation (completed by 18:30 PT):
  * Rolled back a scheduler kernel change that had been rolled out at 17:40 PT to the previous stable kernel.
  * Enabled fall-back to model-042-quantized for the affected route to reduce per-token compute.
  * Reduced max batch size from 64->24 and tightened batch-timeout to 12ms for the route.
  * Temporarily routed FastCommerce traffic to their dedicated capacity pool in us-west-2 while we stabilize.
- Why we think it happened: Kernel scheduling change increased tail queueing under peak concurrency for longer sequences; quantized model fallback and reduced batching reduced queueing and dropped p99 back to ~140ms.

Open follow-ups (owners / ETA):
- Full RCA with kernel trace analysis and perf graphs (Aditya) — EOD tomorrow.
- Postmortem doc and customer-facing summary + proposed credit (Marissa) — draft by tomorrow AM.
- Routing policy hardening to avoid single-kernel rollouts during known customer peaks (Grace + Markus) — proposal by next week.

Miguel — we'll send a short customer-facing note once Marissa drafts it. Apologies for the disruption; we appreciate the quick reporting which helped the remediation.
